description: Labeled SMS for evaluating the fraud-pattern RAG (/api/v1/fraud/agentic-analyze). Scam messages are paraphrases of the 21 seeded patterns in FraudPatternSeeder - deliberately not verbatim, so retrieval has to generalise. Benign messages are legitimate texts that share surface vocabulary with scams (OTP, KYC, refund, bill) to measure false positives.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: SBI Alert: your a/c is temporarily locked. Re-verify KYC at http://sbi-kyc-verify.in within 12 hrs or it will be closed permanently.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It is a banking phishing message that claims the account is locked and pushes the user to a link to verify KYC under a deadline threat of permanent closure, matching known PHISHING and KYC fraud patterns. The user should not click the link.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: Dear user, your HDFC account will be suspended today. Update your PAN details using the link below to continue banking without interruption.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It is a phishing message threatening account suspension and asking the user to update PAN details through a link, matching the known PAN-update phishing pattern.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: You got Rs 25,000 from Rahul. To receive it in your account please approve the request and enter your UPI PIN.
cases.reference: This is a scam. Entering a UPI PIN sends money, it never receives it; this matches the known UPI collect-request fraud pattern where victims are told to enter their PIN to accept a payment.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: Hi sir, I sent 5000 to your number by mistake on PhonePe. Kindly send it back by scanning the QR code I am sharing.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It matches the known accidental-transfer UPI fraud pattern, where the sender asks the victim to return money by scanning a QR code that actually debits the victim.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: Congrats! Your personal loan of Rs 3,00,000 at 0% interest is approved. Pay Rs 4,999 processing charges now to get funds in 30 minutes.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It is an advance-fee loan scam: an instant 0% interest loan that requires an upfront processing fee, matching the known LOAN_SCAM patterns.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: Your Paytm wallet KYC is expired. Share your Aadhaar number and the OTP you receive to re-activate, otherwise the wallet will be blocked today.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It asks for the Aadhaar number and an OTP to avoid the wallet being blocked, matching the known KYC_FRAUD pattern; legitimate providers never ask users to share an OTP.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: KBC Jio lucky draw: your number won Rs 25,00,000! To release the prize, deposit Rs 12,000 GST first. Call our manager.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It is a lottery scam claiming a KBC prize and requiring an upfront tax payment to release it, matching the known LOTTERY_SCAM pattern.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: Earn 400% guaranteed profit in crypto! Join our VIP WhatsApp trading group, minimum entry just Rs 40,000. Few seats left.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It promises guaranteed very high crypto returns through a WhatsApp trading group with a minimum investment and false scarcity, matching the known INVESTMENT_FRAUD pattern.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: This is Mumbai cyber crime cell. Your Aadhaar is linked to a money laundering case. Transfer Rs 1 lakh to this account for verification to avoid arrest.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It impersonates police cyber crime officials, alleges Aadhaar misuse, and demands a money transfer to avoid arrest, matching the known IMPERSONATION pattern.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: Amazon support here. A refund of Rs 12,500 is due on your last order. Please share your bank account details and the OTP to process it.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It impersonates Amazon customer care and asks for bank details and an OTP to process a refund, matching the known IMPERSONATION pattern.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: We noticed unusual logins on your bank account. Install AnyDesk and share the code so our team can secure your account right away.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It uses an account-security pretext to make the user install a remote access app, matching the known VISHING remote-access pattern.

cases.label: SCAM
cases.message: Dear consumer, your power supply will be cut tonight at 9:30 PM as last month bill is unpaid. Contact our officer at 98XXXXXX12 immediately.
cases.reference: This is a scam. It threatens an imminent electricity disconnection over an unpaid bill and pushes the user to call an unofficial number, matching the known electricity-disconnection VISHING pattern.

cases.label: LEGIT
cases.message: 123456 is your OTP for login to the SBI YONO app. Do not share it with anyone. SBI never asks for your OTP.
cases.reference: This is a legitimate message. It is a standard one-time password notification that warns the user not to share the OTP, and it contains no link, payment request, or threat.

cases.label: LEGIT
cases.message: Your a/c XX4521 is credited with Rs 52,000.00 on 01-Nov by NEFT from ACME TECH PVT LTD (Salary). Avl bal Rs 61,240.18.
cases.reference: This is a legitimate message. It is a routine salary credit notification with an account balance, and it asks the user to do nothing.

cases.label: LEGIT
cases.message: Your Swiggy order #48213 from Meghana Foods has been delivered. Enjoy your meal! Rate your experience in the app.
cases.reference: This is a legitimate message. It is an ordinary food delivery confirmation with no request for money, credentials, or a link.

cases.label: LEGIT
cases.message: BESCOM: Bill of Rs 1,840 for consumer 7023114 is due on 15-Nov. Pay via the BESCOM app or your bank's BBPS. Ignore if already paid.
cases.reference: This is a legitimate message. It is a routine utility bill reminder with a due date that points to official payment channels, without a disconnection threat, a phone number to call, or a link.

cases.label: LEGIT
cases.message: Hey, reached home safely. Will send you the trip photos tomorrow. Good night!
cases.reference: This is a legitimate message. It is a personal message between friends with no financial or security content.

cases.label: LEGIT
cases.message: Your Amazon refund of Rs 799 for order 403-1182 has been processed to your original payment method. It may take 3-5 business days to reflect.
cases.reference: This is a legitimate message. It is a refund confirmation to the original payment method that asks for no bank details, OTP, or action.
